plugin.name: WhereWasI.ini
plugin.description: Your choice is written to Data/SKSE/Plugins/WhereWasI.ini (in MO2: this mod's folder, SKSE/Plugins/WhereWasI.ini). Edit it any time: fMinHoursAway is in hours (24 = 1 day, 168 = 1 week, 0 = every load). bShowQuest, bShowLocation and bShowSnapshot (level, gold, bounty) turn lines on (1) or off (0). Changes take effect the next time the game starts.
